# StructuPath Herdr Suite

> Canonical suite documentation for four open-source MIT-licensed Herdr plugins. Compatibility and testing evidence is plugin-specific and pinned in https://github.com/StructuPath/herdr-suite-site/blob/main/data/plugins.json.

Canonical docs: https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/
Source Markdown: https://github.com/StructuPath/herdr-suite-site/tree/main/docs-src

## Trust and composition boundaries

- Guard is advisory/best-effort for agent TUIs. It sees rendered terminal text, not authoritative tool intent; native harness or sandbox controls remain authoritative.
- Swarm independently creates and harvests Swarm-owned worktrees for interchangeable fan-out agents.
- Conductor currently creates and reconciles Conductor-owned worktrees itself. It does not delegate worktree creation or harvest to Swarm.
- Write-capable agents and plugins are trusted same-user principals. Worktrees isolate changes for review, not filesystem or process access.

## Plugins and pinned compatibility

- Browser (`structupath.browser`) release 0.5.0: Herdr >=0.7.0; README evidence records testing with 0.7.4. Live/drivable workspace browser session, separate interactive browse, and WebM recording. https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/browser/
- Guard (`structupath.guard`) release 0.1.0: Herdr >=0.7.5; evidence records 0.7.5. Advisory command policy: audit, alert, and best-effort interrupt. https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/guard/
- Swarm (`structupath.swarm`) release 0.1.0: Herdr >=0.7.4; evidence records 0.7.4 and 0.7.5 paths. Worktree-per-agent fan-out and review-first harvest. https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/swarm/
- Conductor (`structupath.conductor`) release 0.1.0: Herdr >=0.7.5; evidence records 0.7.5. Role-differentiated agent team as visible panes with file-sentinel completion. https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/conductor/

## Conductor actions

Conductor exposes exactly five actions:

1. `structupath.conductor.assemble` — stand up the declared team and open the board.
2. `structupath.conductor.board` — open the live worker board.
3. `structupath.conductor.status` — print one-shot run status.
4. `structupath.conductor.harvest` — reconcile writer branches in a Conductor integration worktree.
5. `structupath.conductor.stand-down` — close verified Conductor-owned worker panes while keeping Git work.

The supervised quickstart is at https://herdr.structupath.ai/docs/conductor/ and explicitly identifies autonomous supervisor approval, Swarm delegation, and report attestation as not implemented in the pinned runtime.

## Install

Commands documented by the plugin repositories:

`herdr plugin install StructuPath/herdr-browser`
`herdr plugin install StructuPath/herdr-guard`
`herdr plugin install StructuPath/herdr-swarm`
`herdr plugin install StructuPath/herdr-conductor`

These commands are not a blanket marketplace-availability claim. Inspect each manifest and repository before installing same-user plugin code.
